_meta.what_this_is: Pairs of answers to judge, for an LLM-as-judge pairwise eval. Each pair gives the TRUE quality of answer A and answer B (a fixture stand-in for ground truth) and the truly-better label. The judge we model has a position bias: it adds a bonus to whichever answer is presented FIRST. So its verdict depends on presentation order, not just quality. The point: judging in a single fixed order credits position, not merit -- run both orders and a pair whose verdict flips is one the judge cannot actually call.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. Qualities and the position_bias are hand-authored so the flips, abstentions, and the single-order errors are exact and checkable.
_meta.format: position_bias (bonus to the first-presented answer); pairs [{id, a_quality, b_quality, truly_better}]
